threads.body: This PR removes the old "NOT RECOMMENDED by default" exception for `parameters`. With content capture enabled, the general rule "Instrumentations SHOULD populate fields when values are available" now covers parameter schemas too. Not every reference scenario follows that yet. In `reference/scenarios/langchain/scenario.py:81-84`, `gen_ai.tool.definitions` on the `invoke_agent` span still records only `type`, `name` and `description`. The `@tool`-decorated `get_weather(location: str)` is passed to `create_agent(tools=[get_weather])`, and LangChain exposes its argument schema on the tool object (for example, `get_weather.tool_call_schema.model_json_schema()` or `convert_to_openai_tool(get_weather)["function"]["parameters"]`). Other framework scenarios (crewai, pydantic-ai, openai-agents) already fill in `parameters` from their runtime tool objects. Under the repo's reference-evaluation guidance, a scenario that could emit a field but doesn't should be flagged. Please populate `parameters` from the LangChain tool so this scenario matches the updated convention.
